title: self-learning-skills: a meta-skill that saves hard-won agent solutions as reusable rules
description:
Self-learning-skills is a meta-skill that teaches your agent to recognize when it just earned a hard-won golden path, and save it where the tool auto-loads it next time. A new skill file, a Cursor rule, an AGENTS.md entry, whatever fits. It captures dead ends too, since knowing what not to try again is worth as much as the win. It triages what's worth keeping so your config doesn't bloat with one-liners. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/Kulaxyz/self-learning-skills
